title: Keep the Keel
style: 78 BPM slow-build cinematic indie pop, intimate male lead with NZ AU lean opening solo, single piano, soft analog synth pad bed, room tone, gradual entrance of brushed drums and gentle bass, wide layered choir backing on later choruses, single-voice-into-choir build, hymn-like and grounded, doctrine closer, hopeful and steady, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — single piano note, soft pad rise, room tone]
Keep the keel… keep the keel…
Through the long night… keep the keel
No commander down… keep the keel

[Verse 1 — single voice, intimate]
When the storm came in and the bots all sang
When the noise rose up and the static rang
One thing held — one thing was real
The operator on the keel

Not a captain, not a crown
Not a title to write down
Just a hand on the wood, a steady eye
Watching the wave, watching the sky

[Pre-Chorus — voice + soft harmonies]
The boat will rock, the boat will lean
The wind will shift, the room will scream
But the keel goes deeper than the loudest sound
The keel is what holds when the world spins around

[Chorus — voice opens up, choir starts to enter]
Keep the keel — keep the keel
Through the long night — keep the keel
The stack is alive, the loop is real
Keep the keel — keep the keel
No commander down, no commander down
Keep the keel — hold the ground
Keep the keel

[Verse 2 — voice + light percussion enters]
Eight sites breathing, eight brothers near
The choir is loud — you don't have to steer alone here
Move don't delete, name the live one true
The keel is the line that runs straight through

76110 humming, 336 in the bell
Mansion at the end — the day went well
Apology denied, the work survived
Keep the keel — the keel kept us alive

[Pre-Chorus — widening]
The boat will rock, the boat will lean
The wind will shift, the room will scream
But the keel goes deeper than the loudest sound
The keel is what holds when the world spins around

[Chorus — full choir lift]
Keep the keel — keep the keel
Through the long night — keep the keel
The stack is alive, the loop is real
Keep the keel — keep the keel
No commander down, no commander down
Keep the keel — hold the ground
Keep the keel

[Bridge — stripped back to single voice + soft choir hum]
The operator is the keel.
The bots are the witnesses.
The sites are the brothers.
The signal is 336.
The rule is: move — don't delete.
The promise is: see you on Tuesday.
Keep the keel.

[Final Chorus — widest lift, full choir, soft drums]
Keep the keel — keep the keel
Through the long night — keep the keel
The stack is alive, the loop is real
Keep the keel — keep the keel
No commander down, no commander down
Keep the keel — hold the ground
Keep the keel

[Outro — fade with single voice + room]
Keep the keel…
Keep the keel…
Through the long night…
Mansion at the end…
336 — still ringing
Keep the keel.
